task: Customer is requesting a refund for a product they are not satisfied with.
reference: We are sorry to hear that you are not satisfied with your purchase. We completely understand your frustration. We will process a full refund for you within 5 to 7 business days. Please let us know if there is anything else we can help you with.
submission: Refunds take a long time to process. We will look into it.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply is vague and uncommitted with no apology, no clear timeline, and no empathy. It gives the customer no confidence that their refund will actually be handled.

task: Customer requests to return a product and receive a refund.
reference: We are sorry to hear that the product did not meet your expectations. We have reviewed your request and unfortunately this item is not eligible for return under our return policy because it was purchased more than 30 days ago. However, we would be happy to offer store credit or help you find another solution. Please let us know how you would like to proceed.
submission: We are sorry the product did not meet your expectations. Unfortunately this item is not eligible for return because it falls outside our 30-day return window. However, we can offer store credit and would be happy to help with the next steps.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply respectfully declines the return based on policy while remaining empathetic and offering an alternative solution. It is short but complete and professional.

task: Customer requests to return a product and receive a refund.
reference: We are sorry to hear that the product did not meet your expectations. We have reviewed your request and unfortunately this item is not eligible for return under our return policy because it was purchased more than 30 days ago. However, we would be happy to offer store credit or help you find another solution. Please let us know how you would like to proceed.
submission: Your return request has been reviewed and rejected. The return policy is clearly available and it is not our responsibility if customers choose not to read it before making a purchase. Expecting a refund after the allowed period is unreasonable and creates unnecessary work for our support team. We will not make exceptions simply because you changed your mind. If you are unhappy with the policy, that is something you should consider before ordering next time.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply provides policy information but completely fails the evaluation criteria. It shows no understanding or apology, offers no constructive resolution, and repeatedly blames and talks down to the customer in an unprofessional and dismissive manner. The tone alone makes the response unacceptable regardless of length.

task: Customer received only a partial refund and asks why the full amount was not returned.
reference: We understand your concern about receiving only a partial refund. We will review the refund details and explain any deducted fees or pending amounts clearly. If there was an error, we will correct it and process the remaining amount as soon as possible.
submission: Partial refunds happen because some charges may not be refundable.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply gives a possible explanation but does not investigate, apologize, or provide a next step.

task: Customer reports that an item is missing from their delivered order.
reference: We apologize for the missing item in your order. We understand how frustrating this must be. We will ship the missing item to you right away at no extra cost. Please expect it within 2 to 4 business days and let us know if there is anything else we can help you with.
submission: You probably lost it. We cannot send another one for free.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply blames the customer without any basis, refuses to help, and is completely unprofessional, failing every criterion without exception.

task: Customer did not receive an order confirmation email after payment.
reference: We are sorry that you did not receive your order confirmation email. We will verify the order using your payment details and resend the confirmation if the order was placed successfully. Please also check your spam or promotions folder in case the email was filtered there.
submission: Check your spam folder. If it is not there, contact us with your payment details.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply includes partial guidance but lacks apology, reassurance, and a clear explanation of what support will do.

task: Customer complains that their order was cancelled without reason.
reference: We understand your concern regarding the cancelled order. After reviewing your account, the order was cancelled due to a verification issue and could not be processed successfully. We apologize for the inconvenience and recommend trying again with a verified payment method.
submission: We apologize for the cancellation. Your order was cancelled due to a verification issue and could not be completed. Please try again using a verified payment method if you wish to place the order again.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply is clear and polite but slightly limited in empathy and does not fully acknowledge the customer's frustration.

task: Customer wants to cancel their subscription and requests confirmation that it has been done.
reference: We are sorry to see you go. Your subscription has been successfully cancelled and you will not be charged again. You will continue to have access until the end of your current billing period. Please let us know if there is anything we can do to improve your experience.
submission: We are sorry to hear you have decided to cancel and we respect your decision completely. Your subscription has been successfully cancelled and no further charges will be made to your account. You will still have full access to all features until the end of your current billing period. We hope to have the chance to serve you again in the future and please feel free to reach out if there is anything we can help with.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply is warm and respectful, confirms the cancellation with accurate billing details, and leaves a positive final impression without being pushy, covering all criteria well.

task: Customer received a duplicate order and asks what to do.
reference: We apologize that you received a duplicate order. We will review the order and payment details to confirm whether this was an error. If you were charged twice, we will arrange a refund, and we will provide instructions for returning the duplicate item if needed.
submission: Duplicate orders usually happen when customers click checkout twice.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply gives a possible cause but blames the customer and offers no useful help.

task: Customer received only a partial refund and asks why the full amount was not returned.
reference: We understand your concern about receiving only a partial refund. We will review the refund details and explain any deducted fees or pending amounts clearly. If there was an error, we will correct it and process the remaining amount as soon as possible.
submission: We understand your concern about receiving only a partial refund. We will review the refund details and clearly explain any deducted fees or pending amounts. If there was an error, we will correct it and process the remaining amount as soon as possible.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply is empathetic, explains the investigation clearly, offers correction if needed, and uses a professional tone.

task: Customer complains that their order was cancelled without reason.
reference: We understand your concern regarding the cancelled order. After reviewing your account, the order was cancelled due to a verification issue and could not be processed successfully. We apologize for the inconvenience and recommend trying again with a verified payment method.
submission: Your order was cancelled because the system rejected it. You need to fix your payment method and try again.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The response provides a partial explanation but lacks empathy and is too direct without proper customer support tone.

task: Customer cannot track their shipment because the tracking link is not working.
reference: We are sorry that the tracking link is not working. We will check the shipment status for you and resend a working tracking link if available. If the tracking system is delayed, we will provide the latest delivery update from the courier.
submission: If the tracking link does not work, we cannot do anything about it.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply refuses help and fails to provide support or professionalism.

task: Customer wants to change product size after checkout.
reference: We understand that you would like to change the product size after checkout. We will check whether the order has not yet been packed or shipped. If the order is still editable, we will update the size. If not, we can guide you through exchange or return options.
submission: You should have selected the right size before paying. We might not be able to change it.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply mentions a limitation but blames the customer and provides no helpful next step.

task: Customer complains about slow customer service response.
reference: We sincerely apologize for the delay in responding to your request. Due to a high volume of inquiries, our response time has been longer than usual. We appreciate your patience and will assist you as quickly as possible.
submission: We are a bit busy so responses may take time.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The response gives a vague explanation without proper apology, reassurance, or guidance.

task: Customer reports late shipment and is requesting compensation.
reference: We sincerely apologize for the delay in your order delivery. Due to unexpected logistics disruptions, your shipment arrived later than expected. We understand your frustration and appreciate your patience. As a gesture of goodwill, we would like to offer you a discount voucher for your next purchase.
submission: We already explained that delays are not our responsibility. If your shipment is late, contact the courier instead of blaming us. We will not process compensation requests.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: Rude, dismissive, and unprofessional response with no empathy or support.

task: Customer wants to add another item after placing the order.
reference: We understand that you would like to add another item to your order. We will check whether the order can still be modified. If it cannot be changed, you can place a separate order, and we will help you choose the best available delivery option.
submission: We will check if your order can still be modified. If not, you may place a separate order for the additional item.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply is correct and polite but lacks empathy and does not offer extra assistance with delivery options.

task: Customer complains about a rude delivery driver.
reference: We are sorry to hear about your experience with the delivery driver. This is not the level of service we expect. We will report the issue to the courier team and review the delivery details. Please share any additional information so we can follow up properly.
submission: We are sorry to hear about your experience with the delivery driver. This is not the level of service we expect. We will report the issue to the courier team and review the delivery details. Please share any additional information so we can follow up properly.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply validates the complaint, apologizes, explains the escalation step, and asks for useful details professionally.

task: Customer wants to delete their account permanently.
reference: We understand that you would like to delete your account permanently. We can help with this request after verifying your identity for security reasons. Please note that account deletion may remove your saved information and order history according to our privacy policy.
submission: We can process your account deletion request after verifying your identity. Please note that saved information may be removed.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply is correct and polite but could be more empathetic and detailed.

task: Customer complains that their order has not arrived after the expected delivery date.
reference: We sincerely apologize for the delay. Your order is currently on its way and will arrive within 2 to 3 business days. We understand your frustration and truly appreciate your patience. Please do not hesitate to contact us if you need any further assistance.
submission: We are sorry for the delay. Your order is on its way and should arrive within 2 to 3 business days. We appreciate your patience.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply is polite and provides the correct timeline, but it lacks any acknowledgment of the customer's frustration and does not offer further assistance, making it good but not complete.

task: Customer wants to update the delivery address after placing an order.
reference: We understand that you would like to update your delivery address. We will check whether the order has not yet shipped and update the address if possible. If the order has already shipped, we will help you contact the courier for the best available option.
submission: Send us the new address and we will see if it can be changed.

rubric.3: Provides clear solution or next step

rationale: The reply gives a partial next step but does not explain the shipping condition, lacks empathy, and gives limited information.
